name: Hastings-on-Hudson
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Hastings-on-Hudson, NY
blurb: Kinnally Cove, a small launch beneath the Palisades. The river is about a mile wide here and open to wind from the south.

tide.label: NOAA 8530095 Alpine
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8530095 at Alpine, about four miles across and downriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA ACT3681_1 Dobbs Ferry
current.note: Current from NOAA station ACT3681_1. Flood and ebb headings are the river’s own axis here.
